description: For someone who wants LLC Publishers to handle their New York LLC publication. Returns how ordering works (the order form asks for the LLC's name, its county and contact details; LLC Publishers looks the LLC up in New York State's records, and the customer confirms it and sees the full cost before paying), the order form link, what the price includes, a timeline of about 8 to 10 weeks, and the price for a county when one is given. Only use when the person has said they want to order. Do NOT use for informational questions; the other tools answer those.

county.description: Optional county name to show county-specific pricing and order link

is_foreign.description: Whether the LLC was formed outside New York (foreign LLC). Defaults to false (domestic NY LLC).
